steps.prompt: Create ONE finished premium landscape social-share / OG marketing graphic, approximately 16:9. Original fictional creator platform FOLIO. High-end graphic design: oversized violet angular paper slab left-center, acid-lime background, orange disc upper right, electric blue ink-splash silhouette as a secondary accent. A stylish young adult woman ceramic artist with short curly black hair, wearing an orange work apron and holding an organic white ceramic vessel, is a sharply masked photographic cutout anchored in the right half; believable natural skin texture, confident warm expression, high quality editorial photography. Typography is the hero in the left half: exact large white bold condensed sans-serif headline 'Your work.\nYour world.' placed on the violet slab; elegant intentional line breaks, tight tracking, readable at thumbnail scale, no overlaps with face. Small exact wordmark 'FOLIO' top left in black. Tiny bottom-left exact copy 'A home for independent makers'. Clever overlapping shapes create depth and energy. Asymmetric composition, generous margins, polished art direction, crisp edges. Different materials: photographic person, flat graphic shapes, subtle paper texture. No recognizable existing brand logos, no fake UI, no extra text, no borders, no collage of multiple designs, no watermarks.
